KyoubeAI 1.18.1 lets you close sign-up on a public instance and makes the assistant connection easier to review and publish.

## What's in 1.18.1

**Close sign-up.** Set `KYOUBE_AUTH_DISABLE_SIGN_UP=true` and nobody can create an account, including people accepting an invite. It defaults to `false`, so nothing changes until you set it. To add someone later, set it to `false`, run `docker compose up -d`, let them join, then set it back. `kyoube doctor` has a new `sign-up` line. On a public instance it warns while sign-up is open, and on any instance with sign-up closed it says how to let an invitee in.

**Better MCP docs.** [docs/mcp.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/mcp.md) lists every tool, and the smoke fails if the page and the connection disagree. A new section covers running behind an access gateway such as Cloudflare Access: Claude on the web, Desktop and mobile connects from Anthropic's servers, so `/mcp/kyoubeai`, the two `/.well-known/` paths and `/mcp/oauth/` need a bypass rule. The troubleshooting table shows the core's exact missing-write-scope message as code.

**A demo company for reviewers.** `scripts/demo/seed-review-company.mjs` builds a "KyoubeAI Review" company with sample tables, an app, a project with files, an agent and an invite that joins the reviewer as admin of that company, so every tool works for them. Anyone holding the link joins as admin, so use it on an instance of its own. Running it again puts back the sample data, the files and the agent's instructions, and cancels the agent's open work; [docs/operations.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/operations.md#demo-review-company) lists what it leaves in place. A later run keeps an open invite, because its link may already be with a reviewer; pass `--new-invite` to replace it. The script is for directory reviews and is not needed to run KyoubeAI.

## Update

From 1.18, run `./update.sh`. It backs up first, and `./update.sh --rollback` returns to 1.18.0. There are no database migrations and nothing to set up.

Sign-up stays open until you set `KYOUBE_AUTH_DISABLE_SIGN_UP`. [docs/operations.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/operations.md) says how.

The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
